# ClawSteps - Professional Dog Walking & Boarding

> ClawSteps is Delhi NCR's premier certified dog walking and pet care service, offering structured GPS-tracked daily walks, behavioral stimulation, and cage-free domestic boarding.

## Core Services & Booking

- [Dog Walking Services](https://clawsteps.com/services): 20-min Quick Relief, 30-min Standard Exercise, and 40-min Power Cardio sessions with verified handlers and hydration logs.
- [Book a Trial Walk](https://clawsteps.com/#bookingForm): Schedule a complimentary, 100% free Meet & Greet trial session across Delhi NCR.
- [Current Packages & Offers](https://clawsteps.com/#offers): Explore monthly subscription plans, multi-dog discounts, and boarding packages.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://clawsteps.com/#faq): Verification policies, extreme weather arrangements, and GPS tracking details.

## Company & Knowledge Hub

- [About ClawSteps Pack](https://clawsteps.com/aboutus): Our safety-first philosophy, background-verified walkers, and pet first-aid standards.
- [The ClawSteps Journal](https://clawsteps.com/blog): Expert guides on canine wellness, leash manners, summer care, and Delhi dog spots.

## Service Coverage & Operational Areas

- **West Delhi:** Dwarka (Sectors 1 to 24), Nawada, Uttam Nagar, Janakpuri, Vikaspuri.
- **South Delhi:** Vasant Kunj, Saket, Hauz Khas, Greater Kailash (GK), Defence Colony.
- **Noida & Greater Noida:** Sectors 18, 50, 62, 75, 76, 137, Expressway societies.
- **Gurgaon (Gurugram):** DLF Phase 1-5, Golf Course Road, Cyber City, Sector 48, Sector 56.

## Safety & Standards

- **Equipment Policy:** Strict harness-only policy; choke chains and punitive handling are prohibited.
- **Live Tracking:** Real-time WhatsApp live tracking link, walk route, duration, and potty logs after every session.
- **Operating Hours:** Monday to Sunday, 06:00 AM – 09:00 PM IST.
